research.title: CVE-2026-123890 | VMware vCenter Directory Service Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
research.summary: CVE-2026-123890 is a critical authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service component of VMware vCenter. An attacker with network access to vCenter, and no credentials, can obtain an authenticated session as the built-in administrator@vsphere.local.

research.title: icsScanner: Safe Active Vulnerability Scanning for ICS and OT Networks
